vanilla_noise_corner_share.conversion: @Inject at the RETURN of NoiseChunk.<init> (remembers the world generator of one-cell NoiseChunks without a blender) and a cancellable @Inject at the HEAD of NoiseChunk.fillSlice that runs the slice walk through the shared corner-column table for qualifying NoiseChunks (body written from the behaviour: the same field updates, counters and fillArray calls); an @Accessor interface for NoiseInterpolator.slice0/slice1; per-world audit, canary and runtime flag in the helper. 1.21.1: NoiseChunk unchanged; steps aside next to Generator Accelerator's and C2ME dfc's NoiseInterpolator rewrites (yields)
vanilla_noise_corner_share.license: Minecraft (Mojang): no-copy; the mixins carry only our own logic (helper bons.furious.patch.vanilla_corner_table.CornerShare)

yields.name: Generator Accelerator
yields.why: Generator Accelerator (tested 1.21.1-1.6.2) @Overwrites NoiseChunk$NoiseInterpolator.selectCellYZ / swapSlices / compute and redirects how its slices are allocated; its MixinNoiseChunk, listed in the same mixin config, @Overwrites NoiseChunk.fillSlice, where this switch replays vanilla's slice fill. The stored corner columns and the counter / provider state a hit restores are vanilla's layout, so this switch steps aside whenever that mixin is listed (MixinNoiseChunk itself is the cell fill's yield: one foreign mixin per switch). Found by a scan of the other mods' mixins on the same classes for the 1.21.1 port.

yields.name: C2ME (density function compiler)
yields.why: C2ME 0.4.0-alpha.0.122's opts-dfc module wraps NoiseChunk$NoiseInterpolator.compute (and CacheOnce, CacheAllInCell) and @Overwrites NoiseChunk.swapSlices and updateForY/X/Z; the corner table replays vanilla's slice fill and its counter state (C2ME's code is not read: clean room), so this switch steps aside whenever that module lists its mixin, as the port's other worldgen switches stand aside where C2ME rewrites the same code. Found by a scan of the other mods' mixins on the same classes for the 1.21.1 port.
